mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and both drugs can cause GI irritation; risedronate may impair isotretinoin absorption if dosing intervals are not maintained, and both increase risk of musculoskeletal adverse effects.
action: Ensure adequate spacing between administration (≥2 hours), monitor for GI side effects and musculoskeletal complaints, and confirm appropriate contraception in females of childbearing potential taking isotretinoin.
